text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan shone the brightest among all 
the runners. In the eyes of the 
spectators, she now gleams brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Receiving an outpouring of cheers, she 
wears... a beaming smile from ear to ear. 
Knowing she had left a lasting mark in 
everyone's eyes and hearts.
